response.query: What objective overlap diagnostics and thresholds should trigger switching from Callaway & Sant’Anna to synthetic-control or matrix-completion?
response.answer: Switch from Callaway & Sant’Anna to synthetic-control or matrix-completion when treatment effect heterogeneity is high or when data is incomplete. Use diagnostics like R-squared or missing data rates to trigger the switch.
